segment: Finance bloggers and personal finance sites
primary_pitch_angle: A practical checklist for readers whose TDS, AIS, or refund numbers do not match before filing
qualification_notes: Prioritise sites with current tax explainers, author bios, and real audience comments
reject_if: Generic guest-post farms, paid dofollow demands, unrelated finance coupon pages

segment: Tax journalists, business reporters, and finance editors
primary_pitch_angle: A seasonal workflow for filing readiness, e-verification, refund status, and revised-return decisions
qualification_notes: Pitch concise expert quote ideas tied to a current reader problem
reject_if: Requests for unsupported refund claims or unreviewed statistics

segment: HR, payroll, employee-benefit, and salary communities
primary_pitch_angle: A free pre-filing workflow employees can use before choosing the right ITR form
qualification_notes: Prioritise HR teams with salary, Form 16, or employee tax-help resources
reject_if: Bulk email blasts without consent, forced exact-match anchor text

segment: Colleges, student finance clubs, and placement cells
primary_pitch_angle: Starter resource for first-time taxpayers, interns, and early-career salaried users
qualification_notes: Prioritise active finance clubs, placement newsletters, and career-readiness pages
reject_if: Inactive clubs, scraped email lists, unrelated campus directories

primary_pitch_angle: A filing-readiness workflow for self-employed users who need to organise income, TDS, and bank validation
qualification_notes: Look for communities discussing invoices, TDS, advance tax, or refund status
reject_if: Spam groups, unrelated business directories, guaranteed-tax-saving angles

segment: CA, CS, finance student, and accounting communities
primary_pitch_angle: A checklist for preparing broker statements and reducing back-and-forth before expert review
qualification_notes: Pitch as an educational checklist, not a replacement for professional judgement
reject_if: Communities requiring promotional-only posts or manipulated anchors

segment: Newsletter writers and LinkedIn finance creators
primary_pitch_angle: Timely employee-friendly workflow for Form 16 season with a practical tool link
qualification_notes: Prioritise creators who already publish tax explainers and disclose sponsorships
reject_if: Paid dofollow-only placements, exaggerated outcome claims

segment: Resource pages, calculator lists, and tax guide roundups
best_asset_to_pitch: Income tax calculator and regime comparator
primary_pitch_angle: Useful tools for old-vs-new-regime and filing-readiness pages
qualification_notes: Check that the page is indexed, maintained, and topically relevant
reject_if: Low-quality directories, automated submission pages, irrelevant roundups

segment: Partner/referral prospects already known to MyeCA
primary_pitch_angle: Partner-ready hub with clear routes into tools, filing selector, and expert consultation
qualification_notes: Use relationship context and make co-branded copy optional
reject_if: Partners asking for undisclosed paid links or refund guarantees
